name: TODAY
description: TODAY returns the current date, updated each time the worksheet recalculates.
tldr: TODAY displays today's date, updating automatically when the workbook opens or recalculates.

basicExample.explanation: Returns the current date as a serial number formatted as a date.

advancedExamples.title: Calculate days until deadline
advancedExamples.description: Find how many days remain until a deadline
advancedExamples.explanation: Subtracts today's date from the deadline date in cell A1.

advancedExamples.title: Calculate age from birthdate
advancedExamples.description: Compute someone's age from their birthdate
advancedExamples.explanation: DATEDIF calculates the difference in years between birthdate and today.

howItWorks: TODAY returns the current date as a serial number (Excel date format). It updates automatically whenever the workbook is opened or recalculated.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the date should appear.

limitations: TODAY returns only the date, not the time.
For date and time, use NOW() instead.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: TODAY works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Does TODAY update automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, TODAY updates whenever the worksheet recalculates or when you open the workbook.

faq.question: Can I use TODAY in conditional formatting?
faq.answer: Yes, TODAY() is commonly used in conditional formatting rules.
